title: "The Reality of the Artistic Object"
description: Our newest publication, offering a critical introduction to Graham Harman's philosophy.
body: "The Reality of the Artistic Object," written by Vangeesa Sumanasekara as a critical introduction to Graham Harman's philosophy, has just been released.
This is another step in our long-term project of introducing the newest developments in Object-Oriented Ontology to Sinhala readers.

title: Colombo School of Philosophy Inaugural Ceremony
description: Our official inaugural ceremony was held at the Mahaweli Centre.
body: After nearly a decade of informal work, the Colombo School of Philosophy was officially inaugurated at a ceremony held at the Mahaweli Centre.
The event was attended by students, lecturers, and long-time collaborators. Our vision for the years ahead, under the motto “Beyond the 90s,” was announced at this occasion.

title: "The Politics of Universality" Launch
description: A new book by Ranga Manupriya, Waranga de Silva, and Vangeesa Sumanasekara.
body: "The Politics of Universality," which examines the origin, promise, and crisis of the liberatory self, was launched at the Colombo International Book Fair 2024.
The book, co-authored by Ranga Manupriya, Waranga de Silva, and Vangeesa Sumanasekara, was published by Agahas Publications.

title: Discussions on Theism
description: An open series of discussions on theism and religious philosophy.
body: An open series of discussions on theism and religious philosophy was held through CSP's reading circles.
These discussions offered a critical examination of both classical and contemporary arguments for theism.
